exportSummaries.MOUTH_OPEN_CAP: #460 — cap FACS `mouth-open` at 0.3: the last weight where the parent's face survives.
exportSummaries.applyBlinkClosureToRoot: Drive both lid-closure morphs on every mesh under root that carries them, from a blink intensity in [0,1].
exportSummaries.applyGazeToHumanoid: Drive the skinned eye bones on whatever rig `root` carries.
exportSummaries.applyGeneratedScalarVisemeToRoot: Generated-drive scalar path: map a lip-sync weight to AA vs silence (named), never index 0.
exportSummaries.applyNamedSpeechVisemes: Thin speech-path entry: phoneme timeline from active dialogue → named morph weights.
exportSummaries.attachBakedCuesToSpeech: #722 — the join, as a call main.ts makes once per dialogue: load the served cue file for the spoken line and attach it to the active speech so the wire drives the bake's real timing.
exportSummaries.collectResolvedMorphTargets: #730: accumulate the first per-mesh resolution of each canonical name onto `acc` (null until a mesh under the root resolves it).
exportSummaries.initialDialogueTextForScenario: Resolve the Mock Dialogue panel text for a station.
exportSummaries.loadBakedMouthCuesForUtterance: Load the baked cue file for a spoken line, when one exists.
exportSummaries.phonemesForText: The phoneme sequence the mouth animates to / that feeds evidence and the duration estimate.
exportSummaries.resolveMorphIndex: Resolve a canonical runtime morph name to a dictionary index on a given body, or undefined.
exportSummaries.visemesForText: The viseme sequence the mouth animates to — `phonemesForText` mapped through the resolver.
